titleEn: Find First Palindromic String in the Array
title: 找出数组中的第一个回文字符串
summary: 按数组顺序返回第一个正反读相同的字符串，不存在返回空串。
insight: 逐词使用双指针从两端比较；首个全部匹配的词立即返回。

solutions.title: 顺序双指针回文检查
solutions.idea: 逐个单词验证两端字符。
steps: 全部相等立即返回 word；结束返回空串

code.java: class Solution { private boolean palindrome(String word){for(int left=0,right=word.length()-1;left<right;left++,right--)if(word.charAt(left)!=word.charAt(right))return false;return true;}public String firstPalindrome(String[] words){for(String word:words)if(palindrome(word))return word;return "";} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun palindrome(word:String):Boolean{var left=0;var right=word.lastIndex;while(left<right)if(word[left++]!=word[right--])return false;return true};fun firstPalindrome(words:Array<String>)=words.firstOrNull{palindrome(it)}?:"" }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool palindrome(string word){return equal(word.begin(),word.begin()+word.size()/2,word.rbegin());}public: string firstPalindrome(vector<string>& words){for(string& word:words)if(palindrome(word))return word;return"";} };
